name: Text Normalization
descr: Converts orthography of transcribed IPUs into a normalized tokenized form: word segmented, numerals converted into words, expanded abbreviations, punctuation removed, etc. Produces the IPUs with normalized tokens.

options.text: Input pattern of the file with the orthographic transcription.
Output file pattern with the normalized text.

Create a tier with the faked tokens
Create a tier with the standard tokens (useful if EOT)
Create a customized tier (useful if EOT)
Create tiers with number of tokens and duration of each IPU
Do not count all tokens but only the speech ones - i.e. no events
